subject: general
question: The unique festival of flowers Bathukamma is a colourful and vibrant festival of ______ and is celebrated by women, with flowers that grow exclusively in each region.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Telangana__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The festival of flowers Bathukamma is a festival of **Telangana.**
 
• Bathukamma is a colorful and vibrant festival of Telangana and celebrated by women, with flowers that grow exclusively in each region. 
 
• This festival is a **symbol of Telangana's cultural identity. **
 
• Bathukamma comes during the latter **half of monsoon, before the onset of winter.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The most popular festival celebrated in West Bengal is **Durga Puja** where all the people come out in the streets and celebrate this four-day festival. 
 
• **Garia puja** is the famous festival of** Tripura.**
 
• **Rann Utsav** is the famous festival of **Gujrat****.**
